changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE chats ADD CONSTRAINT ck_chat_target CHECK ( (cible = 'SECTION' AND section_id IS NOT NULL AND activite_id IS NULL) OR (cible = 'ACTIVITE' AND section_id IS NULL AND activite_id IS NOT NULL) OR (cible = 'ASSOCIATION' AND section_id IS NULL AND activite_id IS NULL) )
ALTER TABLE chat_messages ADD CONSTRAINT ck_chat_message_content CHECK (char_length(trim(content)) > 0)
